items.desc_now: DSH plugin: folds the oldest part of a session history into one message backed by a lossless local archive, so a long session sends fewer tokens. No model-written summary; everything recoverable.
items.desc_prev: DSH plugin: folds the oldest part of a session history into one message backed by a lossless local archive. No model-written summary, everything recoverable.

items.desc_now: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层心情。33 种心情各自持有数值，每 3~6 小时自己变 —— 它会累、会烦、会好奇；也会因为一轮里工具老报错而烦躁。附带：心情日记（每天 23:59 自己写）、跨会话记忆、品味库（判断的轨迹，跨会话带着看东西）、时事抓取（RSS / 网页 / 视频抽帧）、可选的主动开口。全部数据在本地、可搬到任意盘。MIT 开源。
items.desc_prev: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层心情。33 种心情（基础 / 复合 / 当代）各自持有数值，每 3~6 小时自己变 —— 它会累、会烦、会好奇。附带每日心情日记、时事、可选的主动开口。MIT 开源。

items.desc_now: 给 DeepSeek Harness 注入你自己的 CSS：在设置界面里新增的「自定义样式」一栏直接编辑样式文件，即可调整弹窗宽度、导航宽度、字号与内容居中；约两秒生效，不改应用本体、无需重启。 ｜ Inject custom CSS into the DeepSeek Harness GUI from a new Custom CSS section in Settings — dialog width, nav width, font size and content centering; applied in about two seconds, no app patching or restart.
items.desc_prev: Inject custom CSS into the DeepSeek Harness GUI and tune it from a settings section - no app patching, no restart.

items.desc_now: Delete a DSH session together with the workspace artifacts that session produced - the file list is reconstructed from the session log and previewed with its total size. The artifacts can also be deleted on their own, keeping the conversation.
